meta.title: Outdoor Wedding Catering & Production in Israel | Mor & Cinnamon
meta.description: Mor & Cinnamon: seasonal catering and full production for outdoor weddings in Israel. Weddings on the family farm, in orchards or in nature, from the first plan to the last drink.
meta.legalDescription: Terms of use of the Mor & Cinnamon website and privacy policy for the quote request form.

hero.title: From the first plan to the last drink

manifesto.title: Local, seasonal, fresh food. An event made only for you.
manifesto.text: We cook with what the season gives: fresh vegetables, ripe fruit, open fire and plenty of imagination. With the same care, we produce everything around the food, from the first table set up in the field to the last glass at the end of the night. Every event starts with your story, which is why no two of ours look alike.

items.name: Catering
items.label: A seasonal kitchen
items.text: A menu written around you: live stations, dishes served to the table and desserts that send guests back for another plate.

items.name: Production
items.label: Full production
items.text: Setup, lounges, lighting, staff and every supplier coordinated. You get married, we take care of the rest.

items.name: Outdoor weddings
items.label: Farms, orchards, nature
items.text: On your parents' farm, in an orchard, in a grove or in the landscape you grew up in. Any open field can become a wedding.

catering.title: A kitchen that follows the season
catering.text: The menu is rewritten for every event, according to the season, the place and your people. Tomatoes and peaches in summer, squash and pomegranates in autumn, and always plenty of greens, fresh bread and fire.
catering.quote: Food that feels like a big family dinner, with the sunset in the background.
catering.menusNote: Examples from recent events. Every menu is built from scratch, and the full proposal follows a first conversation.

production.title: Everything around the food
production.text: An outdoor wedding starts with an empty field. We build it detail by detail, and run it until the last guest heads home.

items.name: Setup

items.name: Lounges & styling

items.name: Lighting
items.text: String lights and warm lighting that carry the sunset into the night.

items.name: Staff
items.text: Kitchen and service staff working as one, quietly and with a smile, from the welcome drink to dessert.

items.name: Supplier coordination

items.name: Running the day
items.text: From the morning setup to the teardown, one of us is there making sure everything happens on time.

process.title: From the first call to the last drink
process.quote: Behind every unforgettable moment there is a whole journey: the first setups, the small details, and the moment it all comes together into one evening.

steps.name: First call
steps.text: Tell us what you imagine: the date, the place, how many guests and the mood.

steps.name: Site visit
steps.text: We meet on site, check access, power, water and shade, and start seeing the wedding.

steps.name: Menu & design
steps.text: Together we build a seasonal menu and a design plan, and coordinate every supplier.

steps.name: Setup
steps.text: The team arrives in the field and builds everything: furniture, lounges, lighting and a field kitchen.

steps.name: The day itself
steps.text: You get married. We run the kitchen, the service and the timeline.

steps.name: The last drink
steps.text: We raise one last glass with you, and only then start packing up.

items.a: Let us know in the form if you need a kosher event, and we will work out the right options with you.

Outdoor weddings and events in nature are our home: a family farm, an orchard, a grove, a private garden or an open field you have not found yet. Still looking for a place? Tell us and we will think about it together.

items.q: What about power, water and restrooms on site?
items.a: Infrastructure is planned ahead. During the site visit we check what is there and what needs to be brought, such as a generator, water, lighting and restrooms, and coordinate the suppliers.
The kitchen, the staff and the setup are planned around your guest count. Tell us how many you expect and we will come back with a proposal.

items.q: How far ahead should we get in touch?
items.a: As soon as you have a date, or even just a season. Wedding-season dates go quickly, and an open field also needs time to plan.

items.q: Can we book only catering, or only production?
items.a: Yes. Catering only, production only, or both together. Just tick what suits you in the form.

sections.title: This website
sections.text: This website presents the catering and production services of Mor & Cinnamon. The photos and videos were taken at events we produced or cooked for, and belong to Mor & Cinnamon and their photographers.

sections.title: The request form
sections.text: The details you fill in (name, phone, email and event details) are sent to us on WhatsApp and, if you entered an email, by email as well. They are only used to get back to you about your event and are not shared with anyone else.

sections.title: Cookies and storage
sections.text: This website uses no advertising or tracking cookies. Only your language choice is kept, along with the preference not to replay the opening animation.

sections.title: Contact
sections.text: For any question, or to ask us to delete your details, write to us on WhatsApp at +972 50-536-8876.
